title: Early access is open: here's what you get

slides.headline: See the space *before it's set.*
slides.body: EventSpacePro is the floor plan tool for event planners, decorators and venues. Here's what you get.

slides.headline: Start from a *template.*
slides.body: Outdoor, indoor and marquee layouts, ready to adapt to your venue.

slides.headline: Describe your event. *Get a first draft.*
slides.body: Type your guest count, tables, stage and dance floor. The AI Assistant lays out the plan for you to edit.

slides.headline: Edit every detail *to scale.*
slides.body: Work in metres with snap-to-grid, and see your chair and table totals as you go.
slides.callout: Totals as you go: 104 chairs · 60 tables

slides.headline: Share the plan, *not version 7.*
slides.body: Invite collaborators, leave comments, and export a PDF when it's ready.

slides.headline: Early access is *open.*
slides.body: Sign up at eventspacepro.com and plan your next event to scale.
slides.note: Built in Lagos for event professionals.
